name: Brian Kemp
stance: Signed a chatbot child-safety law and joined governors opposing a federal moratorium on state AI laws.

statements.text: Signed SB 540, requiring conversational AI platforms to disclose they are AI, bar sexual or romantic interactions with minors and provide crisis resources.
Signed the 17-governor letter asking Congress to remove the 10-year state AI-law moratorium from the reconciliation bill.
statements.outlet: Office of the Governor of Arkansas
